intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryProperties without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context: shared externalized config. Immutable @ConfigurationProperties(prefix="telemetry") record binding ALL operational values; no literal fallbacks in code, defaults live only in application.yml. Fields: boundaries (Map keyed by MetricType name, e.g. HEART_RATE -> Boundary(min,max,minExclusive); a metric without entry has no boundary), reorderWindow (Duration, backfill window), flushInterval (Duration), eventBufferCapacity (int >0, bounded sink size), overflowStrategy (OverflowStrategy: REJECT fails the publish with IllegalStateException, RETRY re-emits up to retryMaxAttempts), latePacketPolicy (LatePacketPolicy: APPEND_REVISION publishes TelemetryBackfillReordered for packets later than the window; REJECT_FROM_WINDOW only validates/publishes them), retryMaxAttempts (int), retryBackoff (Duration), deadLetterCapacity (int). Nested public types: record Boundary(double min, double max, boolean minExclusive); enums OverflowStrategy{REJECT,RETRY}, LatePacketPolicy{APPEND_REVISION,REJECT_FROM_WINDOW}. Compact constructor rejects null durations, non-positive capacities/attempts and boundaries with min>max.
